app.name: Ocy
app.tagline: A quieter rhythm for time at your screen.
exercise.blink.body: Blink gently several times, then let your eyes rest open.
exercise.blink.title: Blink slowly
exercise.close-tight.body: Close your eyes tightly for about three seconds, then open them wide and relax. Repeat a few times.
exercise.close-tight.title: Close your eyes tightly
exercise.figure-eight.body: With your eyes, slowly trace a large figure eight in the air.
exercise.figure-eight.title: Trace a figure eight
exercise.look-left-right.body: Keep your head still and look left, then right. Repeat at an easy pace.
exercise.look-left-right.title: Look left and right
exercise.look-up-down.body: Keep your head still and look up, then down. Repeat at an easy pace.
exercise.look-up-down.title: Look up and down
exercise.near-far.body: Look at something nearby, then shift your gaze to something farther away.
exercise.near-far.title: Shift near to far
exercise.neck-shoulders.body: Let your shoulders drop, roll them back gently, then turn your head from side to side.
exercise.neck-shoulders.title: Loosen your shoulders
exercise.palming.body: Warm your hands by rubbing them together, then rest your cupped palms over closed eyes.
exercise.palming.title: Rest your eyes in your palms
exercise.roll.body: Without moving your head, slowly roll your eyes in a circle, then reverse direction.
exercise.roll.title: Roll your eyes gently
exercise.stand-walk.body: Stand up, take a few easy steps, and settle back where you were.
exercise.stand-walk.title: Stand and walk
exercise.stretch-arms.body: Reach both arms forward, then lift them overhead and lower them slowly.
exercise.stretch-arms.title: Stretch your arms
exercise.water.body: While you're up, fill a glass and take a few calm sips.
exercise.water.title: Have a glass of water
exercise.window-far.body: Look through a window at a distant point, and let your gaze rest there.
exercise.window-far.title: Look into the distance
games.holdUntilClosed: Hold breaks until I close this game
longbreak.body.1: Step away from your screen and take a few unhurried minutes.
longbreak.body.2: Let your eyes rest while you move around or look outside.
longbreak.body.3: Give yourself a little space from the screen before you return.
longbreak.body.4: Stand, stretch, or get a drink at your own pace.
longbreak.body.5: Take this time away from your screen, then come back when you're ready.
notify.absenceCredited: Your time away counted as a long break. The next one is in {time}.
notify.pauseEnded: Your pause has ended. Break reminders are back on.
